program.name: Moon Flow
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Cooler yoga: moon salutations, then hip openers or floor poses.
program.about: A softer practice built on the moon salutation, a side-to-side sequence of lunges and side bends. One day it leads into hip openers, the other into seated folds and twists, and both close with a long rest. They alternate. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
program.split: Moon salutations & hips / moon salutations & floor
